observed: REVIEW_ONLY PR 495 reproduced the distinct post-generation-1 defect: a directly constructed internally self-consistent HostCapabilityReport could enter WP1104 as ADAPTED without proving that canonical assess_host_adapter producer logic ran.

Generation 2 requires positive routes to carry AssessedHostCapabilityEvidence created from explicit TargetEnvironmentBinding, LifecycleBinding and CapabilityObservation inputs and recomputes canonical assess_host_adapter output at the WP1104 consumer boundary.
Direct report-only positive routing now fails CAPABILITY_REPORT_PRODUCER_LINEAGE_REQUIRED; tampering after canonical assessment fails CAPABILITY_REPORT_PRODUCER_LINEAGE_MISMATCH.
Exact candidate head 51ce08df985806a3f60f8505fe87d7d132146a5e passed WP1104 component CI plus state-view-v2 and state-consistency CI.
Exact main commit 1fd867676ef056922711c90b216f6bbbc27cb476 passed WP1104 component CI run 33265980963, state-view run 33265980941, and state-consistency run 33265980957.
accepted_behavior: positive generic host routing cannot rely on a caller-constructed HostCapabilityReport or report digest alone
the WP1104 consumer recomputes the canonical WP1101 assessment from explicit evidence inputs before granting a positive route
BLOCKED input may remain report-only because it cannot grant positive compatibility
generic NATIVE remains gated by exact release/environment/host-family VERIFIED support evidence
route outputs retain zero mutation, completion, physical-host, installer-runtime and whole-system authority
evidence_boundary: Repository-hosted deterministic component and state-consistency CI only. Raw lifecycle/capability evidence authenticity remains a later concrete-host acceptance question; this receipt does not establish actual host capability observation, lifecycle firing, installation, clean-machine acceptance, VPS/HCU execution, physical GRID10/GWT/J-Space behavior, provider/model behavior, effects, completion or whole-system acceptance.
